evidence_scope.raw_private_run: Not read: owner PermissionError; only parent byte-identical public receipts consumed.

helper.semantics: Open and verify finite manifest, full serial buffered preadv in <=8MiB scratch buffers, then inspect all files in8MiB mmap/mincore windows. No warm-path fadvise, mlock or residency pin. Counts are sequential snapshots, not an atomic all-file snapshot. read_bytes are preadv return bytes, not physical RAID IO. cap/identity checks establish trust, not future retention.
helper.admission: warm admitted requires pages>0 and sum(resident_pages)==sum(pages); query admitted=None; all_hot separately tested.

observed.page_size_scope: 4096 geometry independently consistent with every file recorded pages; no live sysconf/probe performed.
observed.pattern: Payload00001..00021 are partial (0.6047%..18.0846%); payload00022..00064 fully resident. LICENSE/README/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES/configuration.json zero-resident. All were fully read earlier; missing pages were not resident in their later query windows. No earlier mincore snapshot proves their prior exact residency.

timing.scope: Construction begin includes event-write then helper verification/read/mincore/result save/healthy/assert and exception sample-finalization through condition-terminal timestamp. Same generated root process supplies both times. Exact helper return or read-end monotonic timestamp was not saved; this envelope is not exact pure warm IO or success Prep.
timing.controller_elapsed_scope: Overall controller started-to-failure evidence field, not cachewarm duration.
timing.independent_postconstruction_query: NOT_REACHED: raw result admitted=False assertion precedes query.

memory_evidence.limits: Initial aggregate availability preceded Store pool construction. It is not warm-phase free memory, per-NUMA-node pagecache capacity or guarantee allocations can use every node. Later explicit configuration and postfailure node meminfo are now referenced separately; original failure-time per-node allocation/reclaim/numa_maps, effective ancestor policies and pressure history remain unavailable. No new probes were performed by this analysis.
memory_evidence.store_pool_scope: Configured pinned pool, initialized before cache preparation per existing event; no per-NUMA placement evidence.

postfailure_configuration.interpretation: Explicit controller MemoryMax/High infinity and empty CPUAffinity/AllowedMemoryNodes; worker1536GiB/head16GiB caps and empty requested CpusetCpus/Mems. No explicit binding or controller cap is demonstrated by these settings. Empty requested fields do not establish effective ancestor cpusets, actual mempolicy or allocations. Per-node meminfo was taken after abort/release and cannot establish failure-time local capacity/reclaim or NUMA cause.

Original kernel/file-page reclaim/readahead traces or controlled independently approved diagnostic; not inferred solely from residency pattern.

not_supported: No evidence of incomplete preadv/short-read, timeout or loader failure: helper returned normal result then exact all-hot gate rejected it.
No inference that RAID slower caused eviction; physical device cache is outside mincore scope.
No attribution to NUMA without original per-node evidence.
No inference that initial aggregate MemAvailable guarantees this page-cache predicate.
No proposal to weaken full-hot requirement, add automatic retries or alter old failure.
